pixel_observations: Letter D printed at lower right corner; thin dark-brown outlines around a few lumens and scattered small brown clusters on a pale gray-blue background; scale bar box with small text that appears to read 2mm.

evidence.quote: D Stain with cytokeratin 19 antibody, which is expressed by cancer cells and by normal biliary epithelial cells

clinical_significance.statement: Authors describe a cytokeratin 19 antibody stain, with cytokeratin 19 expressed by cancer cells and by normal biliary epithelial cells; the case text reports tumor cells positive for CK19.

evidence.quote: The tumor cells were positive for CK8-18, CK7, CK19

limitations: The caption says the marker is expressed by both cancer cells and normal biliary epithelium, so brown staining is not attributed to tumor cells alone; no cell-level interpretation is made.
Scale-bar text is small and low-resolution; stain interpretation comes from the caption and case text, not from pixels.
